note: Timings recorded from actual production system runs during development and testing. Not a controlled micro-benchmark. All runs on CPU-only hardware with no GPU acceleration.

model_load_times.note: First load includes model file read from disk. Warm times after pre-warming at startup.

lesson_plan.observations: 8-12 min range observed. Longer when revision cycle triggered (adds ~3 min per retry).

exam_questions.observations: Shorter than lesson plans due to structured Q format with natural stopping points.

scheme_of_work.observations: Longest content type. 10-week schemes require full context window. Up to 15 min observed.

insights.observations: Fastest: analysis of existing content rather than generative expansion.

ram_usage.note: Peak measured during Phi-3 generation with ChromaDB + TinyLlama both loaded. 16GB system has ~10.2GB headroom after OS and other processes.

rag_retrieval_timing.note: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via ONNX runtime. Sub-100ms consistently.

paper_claim: Full lesson plan generation: 8-15 minutes per session on i7/16GB RAM, CPU-only. No cloud dependency.
